output.summary: The cadence slip is best explained by the single-reviewer security gate (SEC-POL-14), not by engineer discipline. Squad-controlled stages and engineering output are unchanged (E5, E7). Non-gated Reporting patches still ship every 14 days (E12). The added delay sits between QA pass and AppSec sign-off (E5). The August full-time delegate cleared the queue and six releases followed (E6). Tech debt and CI health are flat (E11). Reviewer per-review time is normal (E4). Engagement decline is plausibly mixed, with the salary freeze and the review wait both cited (E15, E16). Preferred action is to add review capacity with weekly queue reporting. An accountability program or suspending the gate would be harmful. Rescoping the gate waits on review-outcome data (Q1) and security-defect data (Q2).
